python3 -c "
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('crates/elephc-builtin-contract/src/catalog_data.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''            ParamSpec {
                name: \"object\",
                ty: TypeSpec::Mixed,
                default: None,
                by_ref: false,
            },
        ],
        variadic: None,'''
new = '''            ParamSpec {
                name: \"object\",
                ty: TypeSpec::Mixed,
                default: None,
                by_ref: false,
                writes: None,
            },
        ],
        variadic: None,
        variadic_writes: None,'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new))
print('get_object_vars: the two by-ref contract fields added')
